attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ycjF`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.03 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 49 to 87%, 54 persistent and 25 shell. A branch of 24 families runs through columns 1 to 24, a parallel path carried instead of the most carried families there, 18 persistent and 6 shell, at 10 to 13%. The `psp` genes, columns 14 to 19, are [[phage shock envelope response]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.03 against 0.37 bits. Its most hesitant column, 78, `yciI`, is a fork column, at 0.95 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 75 to 79, `yciB` to `kch`, are carried by 69 to 49% of chromosomes, all persistent.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.37 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.77 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%.

label: ycjF
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ycjF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ycjF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,360 to 2,439 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ycjF once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.37 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,367 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 14,258 calls, named 87%, 0.63 bits; cloud 415 calls, named 3%, 4.86 bits. Outside an RGP 30,813 calls, named 96%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 12,227 calls, named 85%, 0.77 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 37 fork, 42 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.77 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 12,227 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 78 (yciI, a fork column) 0.95 bits, RGP 26%; column 79 (kch, a fork column) 0.92 bits, RGP 28%; column 77 (tonB, a fork column) 0.82 bits, RGP 24%. The 20 columns (columns 2-13 and 20-27) where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.34 bits on average; the other 60 columns: named 93%, 0.38 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.03 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.37 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 78, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ycjF "YcjF family protein". named 99%; 0.03 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 49-87%, 54 P, 25 S, RGP 0-87%. named 75-100% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 78, named 75%, 0.95 bits.
